run_vad_trim_audio_module: run the VADTrimAudioModule to trim silence from audio files in a TSV manifest
trim_audio_with_vad: trim silence from the start and end of audio using VAD timestamps and thresholds
load_audio_from_manifest: load audio from a TSV manifest line and return a waveform tensor and metadata
save_trimmed_audio_wav: save a trimmed audio segment as a WAV file using torchaudio with xxhash naming
configure_vad_trim_audio: configure VADTrimAudioConfig with shards, audio column, output dir, model path, and VAD thresholds
